$comment: Deliberately partial (ADR 0007, question 8): only scheduleTime is described and closed. Every other top-level key is left unconstrained, so existing values files and --reuse-values upgrades keep rendering; guards for the rest stay as fail calls in _preflight.tpl/_helpers.tpl. Close another block only in its own change.

scheduleTime.description: dws-schedule-time, the time-trigger scheduler (scheduling Phase 6a, ADR 0013). Core layer, on by default.

enabled.description: Render the scheduler's ServiceAccount, Role, RoleBinding and Deployment.

replicaCount.description: Scheduler replicas. More than one is safe: Dapr delivers each job to one replica and starts are claimed per instance ID.

afterPollInterval.description: DWS_SCHEDULE_TIME_AFTER_POLL_INTERVAL: ISO-8601 duration (at least 1 s, checked by the scheduler at boot) between status polls of an `after` workflow's current instance.

claimTtl.description: DWS_SCHEDULE_TIME_CLAIM_TTL: ISO-8601 duration the per-instance start claims are kept in the state store.

isoDuration.description: ISO-8601 day-time duration such as PT15S, PT1H30M or P1D.
